summary: Phoenix HEEx layout shells that wrap the Studio UI, the public Bulldocs paper reader, and the Sheets reader — each surface gets a tailored HTML document skeleton with its own asset bundle, font strategy, and LiveView wiring.

intentions.title: Eliminate flash of unstyled content (FOUC) for dark/light theme
intentions.evidence: root.html.heex: the ONLY blocking <head> script is the ~5-line theme-detection snippet; all other JS is deferred/async. Comment calls this out explicitly. Reads localStorage, falls back to OS prefers-color-scheme, and listens for live OS changes while no explicit user choice exists.

intentions.title: Isolate asset bundles per surface to minimise payload
intentions.evidence: root.html.heex loads studio.css + app.js for the Studio; bulldocs.html.heex loads a separate bulldocs.css; sheets.html.heex loads sheets.css. Each layout only pulls the assets its surface needs — readers never load Studio JS and vice versa.

intentions.title: Provide a public reading surface for Bulldocs papers without Studio overhead
intentions.evidence: bulldocs.html.heex is a lean shell (Source Serif 4 body font, no Studio chrome) wired to BulldocsLive. Keeps the reader experience typographically distinct and fast — no admin JavaScript shipped to anonymous readers.

intentions.title: Provide a public reading surface for Sheets without Studio overhead
intentions.evidence: sheets.html.heex mirrors the Bulldocs pattern — separate layout, separate CSS bundle, wired to SheetsReaderLive — so published sheets are accessible to anonymous visitors without loading the full Studio.

intentions.title: Self-host performance-critical fonts to avoid external FOIT
intentions.evidence: root.html.heex self-hosts Source Serif 4 via priv/static/fonts/ + Plug.Static (comment explains rationale); Inter is loaded from Google Fonts with preconnect hints. bulldocs.html.heex inherits the same Source Serif 4 for paper body text.

intentions.title: Maintain LiveView socket and CSRF integrity across all surfaces
intentions.evidence: root.html.heex injects csrf-token meta, LiveView socket script, and the phx-socket path. Every surface (Studio, Bulldocs, Sheets) inherits this through the layout hierarchy so real-time features work uniformly without per-controller boilerplate.
